machine=avocado-qemuarm64
initramfs_file=avocado-image-initramfs-qemux86-64.cpio.zst
kernel_file=bzImage

console=ttyS0
devtype=mmc
devnum=0
bootpart=2
rootdev=/dev/mmcblk0p5

kernel_addr_r=0x1000000
ramdisk_addr_r=0x2000000

# Calculate partition based on avocado_boot_slot
avocado_boot_init=\
  if test -n "${avocado_boot_slot}"; then\
    if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "a"; then\
      echo "Booting A";\
      setenv bootpart 2;\
      setenv rootdev /dev/mmcblk0p5;\
    else\
      if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "b"; then\
        echo "Booting B";\
        setenv bootpart 3;\
        setenv rootdev /dev/mmcblk0p6;\
      else\
        if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "r"; then\
          echo "Booting Recovery";\
          setenv bootpart 4;\
          setenv rootdev;\
        else\
          echo "avocado_boot_slot=${avocado_boot_slot} invalid";\
          echo "Booting Recovery";\
          setenv bootpart 4;\
          setenv rootdev;\
        fi;\
      fi;\
    fi;\
  else\
    echo "avocado_boot_slot undefined";\
    echo "Booting A";\
    setenv bootpart 2;\
    setenv rootdev /dev/mmcblk0p5;\
  fi;\
  if test -n "${rootdev}"; then\
    setenv bootargs console=${console} root=${rootdev} rootwait;\
  else\
    setenv bootargs console=${console} rootwait;\
  fi;

load_image=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${kernel_addr_r} ${kernel_file}
load_initramfs=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${ramdisk_addr_r} ${initramfs_file}

avocado_boot=zboot ${kernel_addr_r} ${ramdisk_addr_r}

bootcmd=run avocado_boot_init load_image load_initramfs avocado_boot
